resources.string: Makes a YouTube playlist with only songs you haven\'t heard yet. Play it in your YouTube app with the screen off.
One per line or with commas, e.g. Karan Aujla, R Nait
One per line or with commas, e.g. punjabi sad songs
Add at least one artist or genre first.
Every song the app puts in a playlist is remembered and never added again. Import your YouTube history once so it also skips songs you heard before.

1. Open takeout.google.com (phone or computer).

2. Tap "Deselect all", then scroll down and tick "YouTube and YouTube Music".

3. Tap "All YouTube data included", tap "Deselect all", and tick only "history". Tap OK.

4. Tap "Next step" → "Create export". Google will email you a download link (can take a few minutes to a few hours).

5. Download the .zip file on this phone, then tap "Import YouTube history" and choose that zip.
The app will forget every song you\'ve heard, so old songs can come back in new playlists.
